question: A truck driver has to cover a total distance of 260 km in 4 hours. He drives at a speed of 56 km/h for the first 75 minutes, and the next 90 km at a speed of 60 km/h. At what speed (in km/h) must he drive the remaining distance in order to complete the journey in 4 hours?
solution:
Given:

The truck driver has to cover a total distance of 260 km in 4 hours.

He drives at a speed of 56 km/h for the first 75 minutes i.e. 1.25 hours and the next 90 km at a speed of 60 km/h.

Concept used:

Time ×&am
